meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Azure 上规划部署或检查资源限制。
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan deployments or check resource limits on Azure.

howto.what: Claude 可以使用 Azure CLI 查询 Azure 订阅的配额、当前使用量和剩余容量，并指导你请求增加配额，或比较不同区域的可用容量来规划部署。
howto.when: 当用户询问配额、服务限制、当前使用量、请求增加配额、配额超限错误，或要求验证容量、选择区域时触发。

say.text: 检查我 Azure 订阅中计算 vCPU 的配额和使用情况。
say.note: Claude 会运行配额检查脚本并返回表格。

say.text: 帮我申请增加 standardDSv3Family 的配额到 500。
say.note: Claude 会执行配额更新命令并跟踪请求状态。

say.text: 比较 eastus 和 westus2 区域的计算配额可用量。
say.note: Claude 会在多个区域查询并对比剩余配额。

howto.what_en: Claude can query Azure subscription quotas, current usage, and available capacity using Azure CLI, and guide you to request quota increases or compare regional availability for deployment planning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks about quotas, service limits, current usage, quota increase requests, quota exceeded errors, or requests capacity validation or region selection.

say_en.text: Check compute vCPU quota and usage in my Azure subscription.
say_en.note: Claude runs the quota check script and returns a table.

say_en.text: Request a quota increase for standardDSv3Family to 500.
say_en.note: Claude executes quota update and tracks request status.

say_en.text: Compare compute quota availability between eastus and westus2 regions.
say_en.note: Claude queries multiple regions and compares remaining capacity.
